howto.name: Upload your PDF
howto.text: Select a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Define each link
howto.text: Specify the page, rectangle coordinates (x, y, width, height in PDF points), and target URL. Coordinates use the PDF coordinate system where (0,0) is bottom-left.

howto.name: Download the linked PDF
howto.text: Click Add Links. PrivaTools embeds clickable hyperlink annotations at each rectangle, opening the target URL on click in any PDF reader.

faq.q: Can I link to other pages in the same PDF?
faq.a: Currently the tool supports external URLs. For internal page jumps, use the Bookmarks tool instead.

faq.q: Are the links visible to the user?
faq.a: The clickable rectangle is invisible by default. To add visible underlined link text, use the Edit PDF tool to draw the underline first.

faq.q: Will hyperlinks survive printing or PDF/A conversion?
faq.a: Hyperlinks don't print (they're interactive annotations) but they're preserved through most PDF/A conversions. PDF/A-1a strips them; PDF/A-2 keeps them.
